method: OpenStreetMap Nominatim search of the official street address from the FLHSMV county location pages. Requests were limited to 1 per second with User-Agent SouthFloridaDMVWalkinGuide/1.0 (https://south-florida-dmv-walkin-guide.vercel.app). A pin is stored only when Nominatim returned an OpenStreetMap address point, building, or office whose house number, street, and ZIP match that address. Points interpolated along a road, and road centerlines with no house number, are not used. Coordinates are not estimated.
